title: eludite.editor.code_cleanup input
description: Run Code Cleanup on a document (Analyze > Code Cleanup, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+E; brief 0069): the steps of profile 1 or 2 (settings editor.codeCleanup.profile1 and profile2): `removeAndSortUsings`, `fixAll:<diagnostic id>` (Roslyn's Fix All in the document for that diagnostic) and `format`, in order. Each step is its own undo step.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
